title: Validation of precise sequences of computationally identified microRNAs by miR-RACE
protocol: Prepare RNA from fresh or cryopreserved tissue or cells using a mirVana miRNA isolation kit and the small-RNA fraction option.
Add 2.5 μl of 5 M NaCl and 150 μl ethanol to precipitate the RNA from the sample.
Place the mixture on dry ice for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 20 min at  4 °C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Rinse the RNA precipitate with 80% ethanol and allow it to air dry.
Dissolve the RNA precipitate in 5 μl DEPC water.
Measure the absorbance at 260 nm if the RNA yield is thought to be >0.5 μg.
Adjust the RNA concentration to 1 μg/μl with DEPC water if the concentration is >1 μg/μl.
Store the RNA solution at -80 °C for several weeks.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 1 hour in a sterile 0.2 ml microfuge tube.
Add 50 μl phenol-chloroform to the reaction mixture.
Mix, then spin at 13,000 g at 4°C for 15 min.
Collect the aqueous phase.
Add 5 μl of 1/10 volume 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).
Add 150 μl (3 vol) 100% ethanol.
Add 1 μl glycogen (20 μg/μl).
Precipitate Poly(A)-tailed small RNA for at least 2 h at -20°C.
Spin precipitated Poly(A)-tailed small RNA at 13,000 g for 20 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 1 ml 80% ethanol to wash the pellet.
Spin at 12,000 g at 4°C for 10 min.
Carefully remove all liquid without touching the pellet.
Air-dry the pellet at room temperature.
Dissolve the dried pellet in 10 μl DEPC-H2O.
Add 50 μl phenol-chloroform to the reaction mixture.
Mix, then spin at 13,000 g at 4°C for 15 min.
Collect the aqueous phase.
Add 4 μl of 1/10 volume 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).
Add 120 μl (3 vol) 100% ethanol.
Add 1 μl glycogen (20 μg/μl).
Precipitate 5’adaptor-small RNA-Poly(A)n for at least 2 h at -20°C.
Spin precipitated 5’ adaptor-small RNA-Poly(A)n at 13,000g for 20 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 1 ml of 80% ethanol to wash the pellet.
Spin at 12,000 g at 4°C for 10 min.
Carefully remove all liquid without touching the pellet.
Air-dry the pellet at room temperature.
Dissolve the dried pellet in 10 µl DEPC-H2O.
Incubate the sample at 65°C for 5 min.
Place the tube on ice for 2 min.
Prepare cDNA Synthesis Mix according to Table 5.
Add 10 µl of cDNA Synthesis Mix to each RNA/primer mixture.
Mix gently and collect by brief centrifugation.
Incubate the mixture at 50°C for 1 hour.
Terminate reactions at 85°C for 5 minutes.
Chill on ice.
Collect the reactions by brief centrifugation.
Add 1 µl of RNase H to each tube.
Incubate for 20 min at 37°C.
Add a 1 ml aliquot of the diluted first-round amplification products.
Add 25 pmol each of mirRacer 3’ primer and mirRacer 5’ primer.
Set up a no-template control.
Mix all reagents thoroughly.
Heat in a DNA thermal cycler for 5 min at 98 °C to denature the first-strand products and activate the polymerase.
Carry out 25 cycles of amplification with a step program.
Dilute a portion of the amplification products from the first round 1:20 in TE buffer.
In a sterile, 0.2 ml microfuge tube, mix specified reagents on ice.
Add a 1 ml aliquot of the diluted first-round amplification products.
Add 25 pmol each of primers GSP2 and GSP1.
Set up a no-template control.
Mix and heat the PCR products in a DNA thermal cycler for 5 min at 98°C to denature the first-strand products and activate the polymerase.
Carry out 30 cycles of amplification with a ‘step’ program.
Separate 10% of the products from the first- and second-round amplifications by electrophoresis through a 2.5% agarose gel.
Use the information gained from this analysis to optimize the miR-RACE procedure.
